entries.subject: DAMIT 4215: selected mesh and original archive spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-4215.txt. Model 4215, version 2019-05-07, pole (150°, 5°), period 24.4987 h match the retained metadata. The archive supplies no diameter for this model; a separate scale constraint is required. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives. The displayed pole and period instead use the later same-mesh occultation fit recorded in the retained calibration and recipe; matching these original archive fields does not make them the active spin.

entries.subject: Dutra et al. (2025)
entries.finding: Same-mesh occultation fit: 118.8 ± 0.6 km volume-equivalent diameter, with refined pole and period.

entries.subject: Registered surface imagery
entries.finding: The grid marks unmapped coverage: no registered global reflectance mosaic was found in the selected releases. They do not resolve local terrain, albedo, craters or regolith. - Elevation is false color for model radius minus a reference sphere, not gravitational height or independent terrain. - Absolute phase is arbitrary; accelerated display spin is illustrative.
entries.revisitWhen: A released, reusable surface observation or mapped product with registration to this body’s selected source model; the existing grid alone does not imply that every archive was searched.

entries.subject: Source mesh and calibration preservation
entries.finding: The [original mesh](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/stored_files/open/13159/shape.txt) is retained without changing its coordinates or connectivity. [DAMIT documentation](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/pages/documentation) supplies the coordinate units, pole and sidereal-period conventions; its CC BY 4.0 terms and other credits are linked from NOTICE.md.

entries.subject: Integrated colors as a surface map
entries.finding: Disk-integrated colors and thermal fits cannot supply a registered surface map. The selected physical scale is the Dutra 2025 occultation fit, 118.8 ±0.6 km, recorded separately; the earlier NEOWISE scale is not currently selected.
entries.revisitWhen: A spatially resolved, reusable observation and its registration provide a measured surface product.

entries.subject: Source pole and period preservation
entries.finding: The original archive pole (150°, 5°) and period 24.4987 h remain in damit-model.json. The [Dutra et al. (2025), Physical Characteristics of Jupiter’s Trojan (1437) Diomedes from a Tri-chord Stellar Occultation in 2020 and Dimensionless 3D Model](https://doi.org/10.1098/rsta.2024.0187) occultation fit drives the presentation. Hanuš et al. (2023), [*Shape models and spin states of Jupiter Trojans: Testing the streaming instability formation scenario*](https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.05380v1), Fig. 13 and Table B.2 proposed a different shape/133 ± 5 km fit whose numerical mesh remains unresolved; the later same-mesh fit is used here.
entries.revisitWhen: Published model-specific definitions, an independently constrained pole/scale, or a released replacement mesh that resolves the recorded ambiguity.
